messages:
deploy-bot: Created release tag v1.14.0 (sha: abcdef1234).
Short changelog:
- optimizer: batch-sizing fix -> ~8% per-token cost reduction
- api: add dedupe header for streaming responses
- infra: healthcheck retry tweak to reduce transient 503s
Diff/notes: https://redwood.internal/changelog/v1.14.0
Planned change window: tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%). Staging already bumped. Tag created by @alex. :tada:

alex: Pushed tag and cut release branch. Staging smoke passed (no DB migrations).

maya: Heads-up — embeddings background reindex will run post-rollout, non-blocking. I'll monitor.

jordan: TL;DR please pin model-serving image on Dedicated before prod traffic. I'll handle node-level pinning if someone confirms image sha.

sam: LGTM on timing. Canary plan: 5% for 15m, 25% for 10m, then 100% if green. I'll start canary at 22:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 22:00 UTC — routing 5% traffic to model-service:v1.14.0@sha=abcdef1234. k8s rollout cmd: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-service model=model:v1.14.0@sha=abcdef1234`.
Healthchecks: initial probes passing. Will post updates.

rachel: :thumbsup: good luck!

deploy-bot: Canary healthy at 22:15 UTC, no errors in 15m window. Increasing to 25%.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% at 22:30 UTC. All nodes updated, healthchecks steady. Release published to prod. Release tracker: RH-389. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/1.14.0

alex: Prod config pinned to v1.14.0 in the console.

jordan: I'll schedule Dedicated image pinning for non-prod tomorrow during maintenance window.

sam: Monitoring logs and SLOs for next 1h. Ping me if any regressions.

deploy-bot: Release tag v1.14.0 created and rollout complete. Closing thread. :shipit:
